description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Revenue growth quality analysis for any US public company. Computes 1/3/5-year revenue CAGRs, growth consistency (coefficient of variation), acceleration vs long-run trend, gross margin direction, and operating leverage. Returns a composite letter grade (A–F) that anchors DCF growth rate assumptions. Chain after income-statements and before dcf-valuation.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Case-insensitive.

name: revenue-growth-intel

delta_vs_longrun.description: 2yr CAGR minus long-run CAGR. Positive = accelerating.

annual_series.description: Year-by-year revenue and margin data, oldest to most recent.

composite_score.description: Raw score 0–100 underlying the letter grade.

grade.description: Revenue growth quality: A / B / C / D / F.

grade_interpretation.description: One-sentence interpretation of the grade for DCF use.

coefficient_of_variation.description: σ/μ of YoY growth rates. <0.3 consistent, 0.3–0.6 moderate, >0.6 volatile.

margin_trend.description: Gross margin 5-year direction: EXPANDING | STABLE | CONTRACTING

score.description: Op-income growth / revenue growth over full history. >1.5 strong, 1.0–1.5 moderate, <1.0 weak.

yoy_growth_rates.description: Year-over-year revenue growth rates, oldest to most recent (decimal).
